meta.description: Book from Paris, Milan or New York for yourself or family flying back to Senegal. WhatsApp confirmation in French or English, payment from abroad accepted.

hero.title: Arrange the arrival from over there, land without a worry.
hero.subtitle: Book from Paris, Milan or New York, for yourself or for the family flying in. We confirm by WhatsApp, in French or English, and we accept payment from abroad.
hero.imageCaption: photo — reunion in the AIBD arrivals hall

changesHeading: What's different when you're arriving from far away

changements.title: Five suitcases, no problem
changements.text: Tell us how many you are and what you're bringing back: we send the vehicle that fits, not whichever one is free.

changements.title: You book, they travel
changements.text: The driver calls the person traveling, not you. You simply get a message confirming they're in the car.

changements.title: From abroad
changements.text: International transfer, Wave, or cash on arrival. The fare is fixed at booking, with no exchange-rate surprises.

longStays.title: Longer stays
longStays.text: Three weeks back home, several trips: day hire or a package for the length of your stay, with the same driver from start to finish.

timelineHeading: WHAT YOU RECEIVE, WHEREVER YOU ARE

timeline.text: Driver's first name, phone number, car model and plate.
Confirmation that he's on his way to the airport.
Message once your family is in the vehicle.

closingCta.title: What's the arrival date?
closingCta.subtitle: BOOKINGS ACCEPTED UP TO 6 MONTHS IN ADVANCE
